prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a human hand pressing a button on an industrial control panel, set in a factory or workshop environment. The hand is positioned in the right foreground, with slender fingers and a natural, slightly tense posture, suggesting focus and precision. The control panel is dark, with a matte black finish and a grid of oval, light gray buttons, each labeled with white text. To the left of the buttons, a vertical row of function keys (F1–F8) and a set of directional arrows are visible. The background is softly blurred, revealing hints of metal fencing and industrial machinery in muted tones of orange, yellow, and gray, evoking a utilitarian, mechanical atmosphere. The lighting is subdued and natural, with soft highlights on the hand and subtle reflections on the panel, creating a realistic, documentary-style mood. The composition emphasizes the interaction between human and machine, with a shallow depth of field drawing attention to the tactile moment of pressing the button. The overall color palette is restrained and industrial, dominated by blacks, grays, and earth tones, with a hint of green from small indicator lights on the panel. The camera angle is slightly off-center, at hand level, enhancing the sense of immediacy and engagement with the machinery.
